reviews.text:
My partner and I decided to enroll our puppy with the expectation of a professional and organized class, unfortunately this was not our experience.

The environment felt very unstructured. Instead of guided interactions, it was mostly chaotic, with limited supervision from the staff. The staff interacted mostly with those who were younger, closer to their own age.  At several moments, more dominant puppies were overwhelming the more timid ones, and the intervention from staff was either too late or not sufficient. This made the experience feel uncomfortable and not very secure.

Overall, we would not recommend this class.
Disappointing experience. The training didn’t seem effective for my dog, and communication wasn’t great throughout the process. I expected better results and more support.

So far we’ve done the puppy class and loved it. The class is very well organized, with 2-3 trainers per class, weekly themes related to things puppies need to learn, and a lot of individual help with the training activities. I really like how the class is a mix of structure and play and the puppies have time to run around with each other. The trainers intervene to teach proper socialization if needed. We plan to continue with the adult class or the shorter workshops. Special shout out to Chynna, De’Jane, and Marlen, who ran our class. They’re excellent trainers and patient with us uncoordinated humans!

Our 4 month old puppy learned so much here. I really appreciated how practical and hands on it was. DJ and Chyna were super patient and worked with us in a patient way that really helped the training sink in. Amazing place!
Hi Tyler, we wish we could make your experience worthy of five stars. Can you please tell us what we can improve?
I've been bringing my dog here since 2019. He loves it here!

I’d go again and again, the staff is the best!  Specially Elisha’s personalized attention from day one.
They treated my three puppies with love and care. I recommend I Said Sit 1,000 times!

My boy Yoshi and I have been coming to I Said Sit for almost 10 years now. Yoshi has had aggressive tendencies in the past but the staff were able to handle him without any issues. Yoshi loves coming here and this is the only daycare / boarding I trust to take care of him when I can't be around. Our lives would have been so difficult without you. Thank you so much.

I've sent both my puppies; Ted Baxter and Liz Lemon to "I Said Sit" School for Dogs where they learned their basics, good manners, crate training and general fun.  Anyone with a new dog should chat with the team to see if their program is right for you.  It made my relationship with both my dogs stronger.  You learn right along side them!

iSaid Sit is the best! The staff and Elisha are amazing! They were patient, helpful and so knowledgeable when it came to working with my fear aggressive dog. I could not take her to a traditional daycare, had no place to board her when we went out of town and little guidance on how to train her until iSaid Sit. They were well worth the investment for my dog and our family!

One of the best decisions we made when we adopted Blackie and Biscuit was to go to I Said Sit for puppy daycare training. At the time, although I had owned companion dogs all my life, I really knew very little about dog training and nothing about positive methods of training. Our experience over the years with Elisha and her entire team has been nothing but positive -- for us as well as the dogs! Also, thanks to Elisha and I Said Sit for introducing me to the world of dog sports, including agility and nose work!

I highly recommend I Said Sit. We loved our experience so much we started with puppy classes and progressed to 1:1 training and eventually ongoing daycare. We can’t thank the team and our dog’s trainer, Marlen, enough for their consistent …

Took my puppy for puppy school and eventually dogcare/training. 4 years later, always get commented about how good my dog is and how well trained she is. If I were to get another dog/puppy, would take them back to I Said Sit given their success rate. Highly recommend!
